system.description: As a free action, you may make a Mental Challenge against a Thaumaturgy caster, bidding two extra Traits; if you win, the power or ritual being attempted against you or your garments fails. This power may only be used to cancel effects directly targeting you. Countermagic works at full strength only against Tremere Thaumaturgy, is weakened by four Traits against non-Tremere blood magic or hedge magic, and is useless against other forms of magic.
